drhp.business: Arihant Foundations and Housing Ltd develops residential, commercial, senior-housing and plotted-layout real estate in Chennai. Over 90% of its projects are pursued through joint ventures with landowning families and institutional partners, and it has leased completed commercial assets to corporates such as HCL and Verizon.

risks.note: Rising property prices and overall acquisition costs may affect housing affordability and moderate demand, particularly in entry-level and mid-income segments.
Changes in interest rates and housing finance conditions could influence homebuyer sentiment and purchasing decisions.
Volatility in prices of key construction materials, labour and transportation costs may pressure project costs and margins.
Increasing competition from larger, better-capitalised developers could impact pricing, land-acquisition opportunities and market share.
Changes in regulations, taxation policies or delays in obtaining statutory approvals may affect project timelines and development costs.
Global economic developments, geopolitical tensions and changes in domestic economic conditions may influence consumer sentiment, investment decisions and overall real estate demand.
Fluctuations in market demand can affect sales and revenue growth; company relies on maintaining a diversified portfolio across high-demand property types and growing locations to mitigate this.
Given the capital-intensive nature of real estate, financing and liquidity risks are inherent to the business.

- Given the capital-intensive nature of real estate, financing and liquidity risks are inherent to the business.
